answer: A split-tally vault bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits in a vault split between two talliers. Each epoch both talliers emit a signed pulse; the two pulse readings must match. A random gale audits 5% of identities each epoch; a copied or rented tally burns both halves. Each filing costs 40, rising 7 per filing: 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once for 40 and keep the bond.
